description: This file defines a Null cache class used in the HTMLPurifier library, implementing cache interface methods that do nothing and return false, indicating no caching.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Null
classes.description: A cache class that implements no caching mechanism, used when caching is disabled.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Attempts to add a definition to the cache, but always returns false.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Attempts to set a definition in the cache, but always returns false.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Attempts to replace a definition in the cache, but always returns false.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Attempts to remove cache entries, but always returns false.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a cache entry, but always returns false.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Attempts to clear the cache, but always returns false.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Attempts to clean up cache, but always returns false.
